news.title: Soccer fans launch global petition urging FIFA boss Infantino to resign over World Cup 'betrayal'
news.lede: GENEVA — A collection of soccer fan groups from around the world launched a petition Thursday calling for Gianni Infantino to resign as FIFA president after he tried to sell future World Cup profits to private investors. The petition with the hashtag InfantinOut also calls for "FIFA to be rebuilt so that the current debacle can never happen again." "The shameful attempt by one individual — the FIFA President himself — to sell off the World Cup to private investors exposed a betrayal football will never forget," the petition said about Infantino's plan for a commercial spinoff, which he dropped amid a furious backlash. The fan groups include Football Supporters Europe, Football Supporters Africa and, in North America, the Independent Supporters Council, plus about 40 national fan groups worldwide.

news.title: Marines v Paras: How to watch 2026 Falklands Cup football clash live
news.lede: It's a battle between two of the elite Armed Forces outfits and on the football pitch, they've been rivals fighting for bragging rights at the Falklands Cup. The Royal Marines will host the Parachute Regiment in Exmouth for a night of football, passion and drama and you can watch every minute live with BFBS Sport. The match will be broadcast live on the BFBS Forces News YouTube and on BFBS TV (for serving personnel overseas only) with catch-up services available on both platforms. The coverage begins at 17:45 BST on 10 September.

news.title: Jonas Urbig grateful about his World Cup experience
news.lede: Jonas Urbig is a name that is quickly becoming a hot topic in German football. Hailed as the next replacement for Manuel Neuer (after Alexander Nübel ultimately fell short), Urbig has had some memorable performances over the last year, and impressed enough for Julian Nagelsmann to send him overseas to join Die Mannschaft as part of the practice squad for the World Cup. “We were all knocked out together; I was part of the group. Even so, it was an incredible experience for me; I got a taste of tournament life and learnt a lot,” said a bittersweet Urbig looking back on the World Cup this summer, as captured by @iMiaSanMia.

news.title: Grant Johnson revelations raise questions over Bafana Bafana’s World Cup camp
news.lede: Former Bafana Bafana goalkeeper coach Grant Johnson has lifted the lid on some of his experiences with the national team, suggesting that not everything behind the scenes before and during the 2026 FIFA World Cup went as smoothly as it appeared from the outside. Johnson, who was part of Hugo Broos’ technical team at the World Cup, made the revelations during an appearance on Peter du Toit’s Soccer Beat podcast. His comments have sparked debate among South African football supporters, particularly around the administration and logistical preparation of the national team. According to Johnson, some of the problems experienced by the team were outside the control of the South African Football Association (SAFA), while others, in his view, could have been prevented.

news.title: FIFA set to announce the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Match Schedule
news.lede: FIFA are set to release the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Match Schedule tonight in Zurich. The schedule will be released alongside the draw for the upcoming Play-Off Tournament, which will see six teams battle for a spot in the final phase of the inter-confederation play-offs. The draw for the Play-Off Tournament will take place at the Home of FIFA in Zurich at 10pm AEST on Thursday, 20 August 2026 and will be streamed live on FIFA.com, TikTok and YouTube. An additional highlight of the live draw will be the release of the match schedule for the final tournament.
